description.narrative: We have invested via Lynx Food Group into Lona Group. Lona Group is an integrated fruit businesses in South Africa, involved in activities across the food value chain. This includes farming, aggregating and packing fruit (citrus, mango, grape, olives, and stonefruit), cold storage and logistics, marketing fruit for export and domestic consumption, and fruit and vegetable processing.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: We have invested into Lona Group alongside a consortium including Phatisa Food Fund 2, Finnfund and Norfund, to continue the development of Lona Group into a diversified, vertically-integrated food business. The investment will support Lona Group in creating enhanced economic opportunities in some of South Africaís poorest areas, primarily for 500 low-income workers involved in the groupís farming, manufacturing, and food processing operations, by supporting the businessís expansion.
